hits.title: Gartner Sells Digital Markets (Capterra, GetApp, Software Advice) for $110M - Archynewsy
hits.snippet: G2, a leading platform for software reviews, has finalized its acquisition of Gartner’s Digital Markets division, which includes Capterra, GetApp and Software Advice. The deal, initially announced in January 2026, officially closed on February 5, 2026, and is valued at approximately $110 million, before potential adjustments, according to filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). ... Gartner first disclosed its intent to divest the Digital Markets business unit in early 2026, naming G2 as the buyer and specifying the assets involved – Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp. Though, initial announcements lacked specific financial details. The financial terms were later revealed in Gartner’s Form 10-K report, filed on February 12, 2026. ... The transaction is documented in Gartner’s Form 10-K filing (accession number 0000749251-26-000112) filed on February 12, 2026, and a related 8-K filing from February 3, 2026. An earlier Form 10-K filed on February 13, 2025 (accession 0000749251-25-000008) covering the year ended December 31, 2024, does not reference the transaction, as the deal was agreed upon and completed in 2026.
